data.gender_notes: Gulzarah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A beautiful, spiritual and calming name derived from the Persian word 'Gul' meaning rose and 'Zarah' meaning garden or bloom. Gulzarah is a name of great significance in Islamic culture and history, symbolizing the blooming of spirituality and peace in one's life. The name Gulzarah carries the meaning “Rose Garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Gulzarah usually hope their child will grow to embody rose garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gulzarah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
